name: M31 Technology Corporation
summary: M31 Technology Corporation provides silicon intellectual property (IP) design services in the integrated circuit industry. The company's products include foundation IP, such as standard cells, power managing ICs, low power optimization kits, electronics, wearable devices, mobile devices, storage devices, automotive electronics, artificial intelligence, IoT, high performance kits, and electrical change order library; memory compilers; general-purpose input/output, high ESD I/O, and SDIO & eMMC I/O; and digital-PLL, analog-ADC, PLL, LDO, and PVT sensor.
